## 1.2 Binding invariants

1.2.1 repository visibility is permanently `PUBLIC`. No transition, rollback, recovery, successor or incident response may set it to Private. Private Evidence is stored outside every repository Publication surface.

1.2.2 no Secret, credential, PII, customer/provider private data, Private Evidence byte, raw or keyed Private-content digest, equality tag, guess-testable commitment, content-derived metadata or Private tier-binding root may enter the Public repository or another Public surface.

1.2.3 the external B0 authority root is `unknown/unavailable`. Candidate NamespaceEntry roots below are deterministic identities only; they are not B0 admissions. Therefore no Protocol admission, source credit, independent receipt or authority consumption is executable.

1.2.4 all identities derive deterministically from exact real input bytes and explicit domain-separated constructors. Pseudo-random generation, suffix-counter identity, fake/mock/demo/sample/synthetic data and unapproved randomness are forbidden. Cryptographic randomness is not authorized by this artifact.

1.2.5 every Requirement contains exactly five fields: `statement`, `defectCauseImpact`, `requiredProofPredicate`, `dependencies` and `sourceBasis`.

1.2.6 every dependency is one literal typed edge to an earlier v1.5 Requirement. Unknown, self, duplicate, forward, range, wildcard, latest, inferred and prose-only edges are forbidden.

1.2.7 the semantic uses graph is the extracted Section 5 manifest. It is compared with, but never defined equal to, the Requirement dependency graph. An unbound used symbol receives zero credit and blocks.

1.2.8 all source members have exact NamespaceEntryRoot, carrier root, parser profile, byte span, member digest and cardinality in Section 3. Raw carrier roots never substitute for NamespaceEntryRoot.

1.2.9 each new Finding, prior Finding, v1.4 Requirement and old obligation has its own CrosswalkRecord, vector, residual-risk record and absent-until-proved independent receipt. Shared targets never merge noMergeKey or transfer Closure.

1.2.10 the only authority-bearing bootstrap output is one atomic `BootstrapAdmissionCommitEnvelopeRoot`. Any partial record, split consumption, separate Permit or missing readback has zero authority and zero Acceptance credit.

## 1.3 Candidate namespace constructor

1.3.1 NamespaceEntryRoot=`SHA-256("MPRR-NAMESPACE-ENTRY-1" || namespaceId || memberCarrierRoot || parserProfileRoot || memberSetRoot || memberCount)` over LF-delimited UTF-8 fields.

1.3.2 memberDigest=`SHA-256(exact UTF-8 member bytes)`; byte spans are zero-based half-open; line spans are one-based inclusive; heading blocks end immediately before the next heading of equal or higher level; table members are exactly one LF-preserved row.

1.3.3 every candidate namespace remains `PENDING-EXTERNAL-B0-ADMISSION`; deterministic construction proves identity consistency only and cannot self-authorize custody, provenance or Protocol use.

This Candidate materializes the complete 292-member candidate index in Section 3; its namespace authority remains pending external B0 and raw carrier roots never substitute for NamespaceEntryRoot.

2.1.2 `defectCauseImpact`: Defect=the predecessor used navigation aliases without eligible NamespaceEntry and member proof Cause=artifact identity was conflated with canonical namespace membership Impact=all rooted preservation and remediation claims could resolve to the wrong bytes or receive false provenance.

2.1.3 `requiredProofPredicate`: two independently implemented byte resolvers recompute all 292 rows from the exact carrier roots and obtain namespaceMismatch=0,spanMismatch=0,digestMismatch=0,ambiguous=0,duplicate=0,rawCarrierSubstitution=0; any unresolved external B0 namespace admission remains blocking and returns exactly TERM-SOURCE-GRAPH-INVALID.

2.1.4 `dependencies`: `none`.

## 2.3 `MPRR-V15-REQ-003` — Closed Terminal tuples and total overlap precedence

2.3.1 `statement`: the accepted Protocol Definition shall implement the exact non-merged remediation for MPRR-V14-HR-F008. the accepted Protocol Definition shall materialize every Terminal as {terminalTupleId,ResultStatus,BlockReason,Recoverability,RetryClass,precedenceRank}. ## 2.7 `MPRR-V15-REQ-007` — Disclosure-safe Public and sealed Private evidence model

2.7.1 `statement`: the accepted Protocol Definition shall implement the exact non-merged remediation for MPRR-V14-HR-F006. repository visibility is permanently PUBLIC. The only PublicReceipt fields are {publicReceiptId,eventClass,publicPolicyVersion,publicAuthorityKeyId,publicAuthorityEpoch,issuedAtObservationId,validThroughObservationId,signature}; publicReceiptId and signature input are derived only from those allowlisted public fields and never from Private content or metadata. Private byte roots, digests, keyed digests, equality tags, tier-binding roots, length, type, count, identity and error details remain solely in sealed Private Evidence. The preserved public content-hash/root-binding clause is explicitly superseded by this disclosure-safe disposition: Public proves only that the external audit authority attested to an event, while exact content integrity and replay are proved only inside the Private tier.

2.7.2 `defectCauseImpact`: Defect=public integrity preservation contradicted the ban on Private-derived commitments Cause=no field-level conflict disposition or metadata leak model existed Impact=implementations could leak guessable/correlatable Private predicates or weaken integrity silently.

2.7.3 `requiredProofPredicate`: a complete information-flow inventory and exact dictionary, equality, cross-run, chosen-input, length, type, count, identity and error-inference vectors show no Private predicate in any Public field or signature input; exact Private replay remains available only to authorized Private readers; leakage returns TERM-PUBLIC-PRIVATE-LINKAGE-BLOCKED.

2.7.4 `dependencies`: `remediation:MPRR-V15-REQ-001`; `remediation:MPRR-V15-REQ-002`; `remediation:MPRR-V15-REQ-003`; `remediation:MPRR-V15-REQ-004`.

## 2.8 `MPRR-V15-REQ-008` — Three pairwise-distinct Review authorities and domains

2.8.1 `statement`: the accepted Protocol Definition shall implement the exact non-merged remediation for MPRR-V14-HR-F007. the accepted Protocol Definition shall freeze exactly three domains: REVIEW-DOMAIN-STRUCTURAL, REVIEW-DOMAIN-SEMANTIC and REVIEW-DOMAIN-SECURITY. The ThreeReviewSeparationMatrix requires pairwise-distinct PersonRoot, AppointmentRoot, outputAuthorRoot and reviewer-agent policy root for all three slots; Producer, QA and Acceptor are distinct controls and may occupy no Review slot. Shared organizational ancestry gives no authorship credit; shared engine/tool/model edges require an enumerated independence allowance and never merge sealed outputs.

2.8.2 `defectCauseImpact`: Defect=three slots did not require three distinct reviewer authorities Cause=domain cardinality was conflated with actor independence Impact=one person or controlling principal could fill all positions.

2.8.3 `requiredProofPredicate`: same person, appointment, delegate, output author, Producer/QA/Acceptor substitution, unapproved shared agent/tool root or replacement without successor each returns TERM-REVIEW-INELIGIBLE; three eligible rows imply three pairwise-distinct authorities and three sealed outputs.
